sections.heading: Why a Dungeon Lootr Code May Not Work
sections.intro: Most claim errors come from account requirements, spelling, an old server or a code that has just expired.

subsections.heading: Check community membership
paragraphs: The game requires players to join the ClickBytes Roblox community before promotional rewards can be claimed. Join with the correct account, return to the game and allow Roblox a moment to update membership.

subsections.heading: Remove spaces and match capitalization
paragraphs: Paste the code into an empty field. A leading space, trailing space or changed character can produce an invalid result even when the entry is still working.

subsections.heading: Try a fresh server
paragraphs: A newly released code may not register in an older server. Leave the experience, start a fresh session and try the claim again.

subsections.heading: Check whether it was already used
paragraphs: Each promotional code is generally available once per account. If the reward was claimed earlier, entering the same string again will not duplicate it.

When several working entries fail together, community membership or the server version is the most likely cause. When only one fails, re-copy that code first. A recent game update can also retire codes without a fixed expiry timer.

title: Dungeon Lootr Aspects – Best Aspects & Tier List
description: Dungeon Lootr aspects guide with how Aspects work, Aspect Gems, current effects, and a practical tier list to help you choose the best Aspect.
searchIntent: Understand Aspects, compare their effects and choose a passive that fits a class build.

hero.heading: Dungeon Lootr Aspects
hero.lead: Dungeon Lootr Aspects are passive traits attached to classes. Blaze, Ruin, Alacrity and Tempest are the strongest general picks in the current practical ranking.

sections.heading: Dungeon Lootr Aspect Tier List
sections.intro: This community ranking favors consistent damage, useful triggers and compatibility with strong class playstyles. Balance changes and class pairings can move an Aspect up or down.

table.caption: Current practical Aspect ranking — September 2026
rows: Top damage choices for basic attacks, bosses or skill rotations
Critical-hit burst or sustain in difficult solo content
Pack control, lightning AoE or longer damage-over-time fights
Parry, dodge or freeze setups that need more specific play

paragraphs: Blaze is easy to use on fast-hitting classes because its value begins with ordinary attacks. Ruin is strongest when you can stay on one target and build pressure, which makes it attractive for boss encounters. Alacrity rewards rapid basic-attack loops, while Tempest turns repeated skill use into a growing damage cycle.

A lower tier does not mean an Aspect has no purpose. Aegis rewards successful parries, Phantom responds to dodges, and Glacial adds freeze and shatter utility. They simply ask for a narrower trigger than the top options. If that trigger already matches your class and playstyle, keeping the Aspect can be better than spending another gem immediately.

sections.heading: What Are Aspects in Dungeon Lootr?
sections.intro: An Aspect adds a passive combat effect to the equipped class without changing that class's core moveset.
paragraphs: The passive can react to basic attacks, critical hits, skill casts, parries or dodges. Some effects add direct damage or crowd control; others create a temporary damage window, healing or a stacking bonus. That trigger is the most important part of the choice. A class that activates an effect constantly can outperform a theoretically stronger pairing that rarely triggers.

Aspects are bound to the class that receives them. Switching to another class does not move the passive with you, so decide which class deserves the gem before rolling. Extra class slots make experimentation safer because you can keep a useful pairing while building a second one.

The current release has 11 commonly documented names: Blaze, Glacial, Fulmin, Aegis, Verdant, Sanguine, Umbral, Tempest, Phantom, Ruin and Alacrity. Exact effect values can move with patches, so use the class panel tooltip when a number determines a major build decision.

sections.heading: All Dungeon Lootr Aspect Effects
sections.intro: Use the trigger and role columns to find passives that activate during your normal rotation.

sections.heading: Best Dungeon Lootr Aspects for Different Builds

subsections.heading: Fast basic-attack classes
paragraphs: Blaze and Alacrity fit classes that can produce many basic hits in a short window. More hits mean more chances to open their damage or speed effects. Ruin is also valuable when that rapid pressure stays on one boss.
bullets: Use Blaze for simple, consistent pressure across rooms.
Use Alacrity when attack speed drives the whole rotation.
Use Ruin when single-target boss damage matters most.

subsections.heading: Skill-focused classes
paragraphs: Tempest is the natural first choice when a class cycles abilities frequently and relies on skill damage. Fulmin can support slower setups by stunning groups long enough to complete a rotation.
bullets: Use Tempest for repeated skill casts and a growing payoff.
Use Fulmin when AoE control helps land the next ability.

subsections.heading: Solo survival
paragraphs: Sanguine is useful when recovery keeps a run alive. Aegis rewards confident parry timing, while Phantom serves players who dodge consistently. These choices trade some universal damage for a mechanic that can make difficult content safer.

subsections.heading: Critical-hit builds
paragraphs: Umbral belongs on a build that already creates critical hits often. Without that foundation the passive will feel inconsistent, but a prepared crit setup turns its burst into a regular part of the rotation.

sections.heading: How to Get and Use Aspect Gems
sections.intro: Aspect Gems apply a random Aspect to the class you currently have equipped.

steps.heading: Use an Aspect Gem
steps.description: Open your inventory, select the gem and use it once to roll a random passive onto that class.

steps.heading: Read the class panel
steps.description: Check the Aspect name and its current tooltip on the class after the roll completes.

steps.heading: Test the trigger
steps.description: Use the training area to try basic attacks, skills, parries or dodges until you understand how the effect activates.

paragraphs: The working code GIVEMEGEMSPLEASE grants three Aspect Gems, making it the fastest current starting point. Challenge Dungeon milestone rewards can also supply gems later in progression. Because the result is random, save spare gems until you have a class worth improving instead of rolling every temporary early-game class.
A normal class Spin can also arrive with an Aspect. Check the class panel after rolling before spending a separate gem, especially when you are trying to preserve limited resources.

sections.heading: How to Choose an Aspect
sections.intro: Choose for activation frequency first, combat goal second and tier position third.
paragraphs: Watch how the class spends most of a fight. If basic attacks fill the gaps between every ability, an on-hit Aspect has many chances to work. If the class wins through large skill rotations, Tempest is easier to activate than a parry passive. If failed runs are the main problem, sustain or control may create more progress than another damage effect.

Separate room clearing from bosses. Blaze and Fulmin can make repeated groups easier, while Ruin becomes more attractive when pressure stays on one durable target. A player farming Boss Rush may value a different passive from a new account clearing normal rooms.

Do not reroll a useful match simply because another name sits one tier higher. Gems are random, and the next result may fit the class worse. Keep a strong working pair until you have enough spare resources to accept an uncertain outcome.

title: Dungeon Lootr Tier List – Best Classes Ranked
description: Dungeon Lootr tier list ranking the best classes for damage, mobility, survivability, and clearing dungeons, with picks for new and endgame players.
searchIntent: Compare class performance and decide which classes are worth keeping, leveling or farming.

hero.heading: Dungeon Lootr Tier List
hero.lead: Sinister Trigger, Awakened Devil EX, Cursed King, Anti Magic and Dreadlord lead the current Dungeon Lootr tier list for damage, clear power and dependable high-level performance.

sections.heading: Dungeon Lootr Tier List
sections.intro: This practical ranking combines damage, AoE, mobility, survivability, parry or dodge protection and consistency. It is a player ranking rather than an official ClickBytes list.

table.caption: Class tier list — September 2026
rows: Sinister Trigger, Awakened Devil EX, Cursed King, Anti Magic, Dreadlord
Elite endgame damage and strong tools for demanding content
Honored One, Unrestricted, Jetstream, Shadow Vagrant, Founder, Azure Devil, Streamline, Artemis, Forge Archon, Witch Gunner, Boxer
Powerful choices with strong clear value or an important progression role
Demonbane, Vacio, Divergent, Wanderer, Cursed Child, Kage, Archer, Shinobi
Solid classes that clear well but give up consistency, damage or protection
Assassin, Flame Bastion, Greatsword, Ronin, Bowman
Usable starting options to replace as stronger rolls arrive

paragraphs: Rankings differ between active player lists because classes are judged under different conditions. Some lists reward peak boss damage, while others value mobility, easier execution or room clearing. The table favors classes that remain useful across several types of content rather than one ideal damage test.

Do not discard an A- or B-tier class that is carrying your current runs. Progression resources, class levels and a matching Aspect can make a familiar build more valuable than a rare class you cannot yet use well. Treat the tiers as a keep-and-chase guide, then adjust for the content in front of you.

subsections.heading: Sinister Trigger
paragraphs: Sinister Trigger is the premium Spin chase. Its combination of damage, mobility and survival tools makes it useful in both rooms and longer encounters. It is also extremely rare, so it should be treated as a lucky top result rather than the only acceptable build.

subsections.heading: Awakened Devil EX
paragraphs: Awakened Devil EX combines rapid pressure with strong skill damage and defensive freedom during parts of its kit. The unlock grows from Azure Devil, giving players a clear reason to keep and level that Celestial class instead of viewing it as a temporary roll.

subsections.heading: Cursed King
paragraphs: Cursed King offers heavy area pressure and protection during important attacks. It is one of the strongest Boss Rush goals because the class can support both aggressive clearing and safer damage windows.

subsections.heading: Anti Magic
paragraphs: Anti Magic is another high-value Boss Rush or Forge target. It pairs strong damage with the tools needed to stay active in dangerous fights, making the long material route worthwhile for endgame accounts.

subsections.heading: Dreadlord
paragraphs: Dreadlord is a difficult special drop with strong value in demanding stages. Its access route is much less friendly than a normal Spin, so build a reliable farming class before making it the center of your progression plan.

sections.heading: Best Dungeon Lootr Classes for New Players
sections.intro: The best early class is one that clears safely, feels consistent and does not require a long special-unlock chain.

subsections.heading: Witch Gunner
paragraphs: Witch Gunner provides useful ranged pressure and can control difficult rooms without standing inside every enemy attack. That safety makes it one of the better straightforward rolls for learning dungeon flow.

subsections.heading: Boxer
paragraphs: Boxer is easy to understand and produces rapid basic attacks. That pattern works naturally with Blaze, Alacrity and Ruin, so the class can stay relevant when it receives a good Aspect.

subsections.heading: Divergent
paragraphs: Divergent is a dependable Mythic option that can support early and middle progression. Keep it while gathering the levels, Coins and materials needed for a more demanding unlock.

subsections.heading: Azure Devil
paragraphs: Azure Devil is the most important progression roll among the commonly chased Celestials. It performs well immediately and later becomes the class prerequisite for Awakened Devil EX, giving every level invested a second purpose.

A new account should prioritize reliable clears over an unrealistic perfect roll. Rare and Epic classes can finish opening content, while a strong Legendary, Mythic or Celestial can become the bridge to special classes. Save extra slots before rerolling anything that already handles your current dungeon.

sections.heading: Best Classes for Bosses and Dungeon Clears
sections.intro: Boss fights reward sustained single-target pressure and safe uptime; dungeon rooms reward AoE, range, mobility and quick target changes.
paragraphs: For bosses, Sinister Trigger, Awakened Devil EX, Cursed King, Anti Magic, Honored One and Unrestricted are strong long-term targets. Their value comes from maintaining pressure while still handling mechanics, movement or dangerous attack windows. Ruin can improve a basic-attack build that stays on one target, while Tempest fits a class that cycles skills throughout the fight.

For general clears, wide area coverage and fast movement often matter more than peak damage against a stationary target. Cursed King and Honored One can control groups, Witch Gunner creates safe ranged space, and rapid classes such as Boxer or Azure Devil can move through smaller enemies quickly when paired with an on-hit Aspect.

Challenge Dungeon also rewards consistency across repeated waves. A build that survives several rooms without losing momentum can outperform a fragile setup with a higher theoretical burst. Sanguine, control effects and defensive class tools become more valuable when the run is long enough for mistakes to accumulate.

sections.heading: How Classes Are Ranked
sections.intro: Tier placement uses six practical questions rather than rarity alone.

subsections.heading: Damage and uptime
paragraphs: High burst matters only when attacks land consistently. Classes rise when they can keep meaningful damage active through movement, enemy patterns and repeated encounters.

subsections.heading: AoE and clear speed
paragraphs: Wide attacks, grouping and quick target switching reduce the time spent in normal rooms. Strong clearing also lowers the number of dangerous attacks a player needs to avoid.

subsections.heading: Mobility and protection
paragraphs: Movement, invulnerable windows, parry support and dodge protection let a class continue attacking safely. These tools become more important in harder content than they appear in a simple damage comparison.

subsections.heading: Consistency and access
paragraphs: A class that works across bosses, rooms and wave content ranks above a narrow specialist with the same peak. Access is discussed separately so a rare class is not automatically placed higher than a practical early option.

sections.heading: How to Get Better Classes
sections.intro: Use Spins for the main rarity pool, then work on special unlocks through Boss Rush, the Forge, quests and difficult mode drops.
paragraphs: Normal and Lucky Spins are used in the Classes area. Lucky Spins improve access to higher rarity bands, so save Luck Potion III rewards for a focused rolling session. Buy another class slot before replacing a useful class, especially when that class is already leveled or has a matching Aspect.

Cursed King, Honored One and Anti Magic can come from Boss Rush class-item drops after deeper floors or from boss-fragment crafting at the Forge. Awakened Devil EX grows from Azure Devil with additional level, Coin and boss-item requirements. Unrestricted also uses a longer progression chain. Dreadlord comes from difficult Underworld Gate content rather than the normal Spin pool.

The fastest plan is usually two-track progression: keep a roll-based class that clears reliably, then farm the special class you want in the background. This avoids turning every dungeon session into an all-or-nothing chase.

hero.lead: Roblox advertises 30+ Dungeon Lootr classes. The current release roster below covers 29 documented names across Spins, Boss Rush, the Forge, quests, mode drops and bundles.

sections.heading: All Dungeon Lootr Classes
sections.intro: The official game page describes more than 30 unique classes. This 29-name release roster covers the classes currently used across major class guides, with special unlocks separated from the standard Spin pool.

paragraphs: The official 30+ figure is wider than the 29-name table, so the roster should not be read as a permanent cap. New release updates can add names or move acquisition methods. Use the in-game Classes menu as the final reference when a newly added class appears.

Rarity describes access, not a guaranteed tier. Boxer is only Epic but can be useful because of its rapid basic attacks. Witch Gunner offers strong ranged play from the Legendary band, while some Celestial and Exotic choices matter because they lead into special evolution or quest routes.

sections.heading: How Dungeon Lootr Classes Work
sections.intro: A class supplies your active combat moveset and levels separately as you use it.
paragraphs: Changing class changes the attacks and skills available during a run. This makes class choice the center of combat identity: one option may deliver fast close-range hits, another controls space from range, and another may depend on skill rotations or defensive timing. Stat choices, equipment and Aspects then shape that base kit.

Class slots let you keep multiple choices and switch without immediately losing a useful roll. Extra slots cost Coins, but they protect progression when you want to test another rarity or begin a special unlock. A second slot is often a better early purchase than replacing a dependable class on the hope of one perfect result.

Each class can also carry an Aspect. Because the passive remains attached to that class, a good class-and-Aspect combination is worth preserving even when neither item sits at the absolute top of a general ranking.

sections.heading: Dungeon Lootr Class Rarities
sections.intro: The roll pool runs from Rare through Exotic, while several Celestial and Exotic classes come from other systems.
paragraphs: Normal and Lucky rates have appeared differently in some early-release guides, while the current September tables above are shared by recent class references. Check the live Classes screen after an update before spending a large stock of Spins.

Lucky Spins move much more weight into Epic, Legendary, Mythic and Celestial outcomes. Their Exotic chance is still extremely small, so Sinister Trigger should be treated as an exceptional pull rather than the baseline for a playable account.

The other classes use dedicated requirements. Some ask for deep Boss Rush progress or boss fragments at the Forge. Others require a base class at a certain level, Coins and a mode-specific material. Keeping these routes separate prevents wasted Spins on a class that cannot appear in the roll pool.

Awakened Devil EX and Unrestricted reward planning. Azure Devil is worth leveling because it feeds the Awakened Devil EX route. Honored One should also be preserved and developed when Unrestricted is the goal. These prerequisites are a strong reason to own extra class slots before chasing another roll.

sections.heading: Which Class Should You Keep?
sections.intro: Keep the class that clears your current content reliably, then compare it with the cost and purpose of the next upgrade.
paragraphs: Sinister Trigger, Awakened Devil EX, Cursed King, Anti Magic and Dreadlord are premium endgame targets. Honored One, Unrestricted, Jetstream, Azure Devil, Witch Gunner and Boxer can also be valuable depending on progress and playstyle. The separate ranking page explains the performance tradeoffs without turning this roster into a second tier list.

For a new account, keep a solid Legendary, Mythic or Celestial rather than rerolling blindly. Witch Gunner helps players keep distance, Boxer pairs well with on-hit Aspects, Divergent is a reliable Mythic, and Azure Devil supports both current clearing and a later evolution.

Replace a class when the new option improves a real problem: slow room clears, weak boss pressure, poor mobility or frequent deaths. Do not replace one simply because its rarity color is lower. A leveled class with a compatible passive can remain the better tool for many sessions.

faq.question: How many Dungeon Lootr classes are there?
faq.answer: The official Roblox page advertises more than 30 unique classes. The current release table lists 29 documented names, and future updates can expand the roster.

faq.question: How do I get a new class?
faq.answer: Use Normal or Lucky Spins in the Classes area for the main roll pool. Special classes come from Boss Rush, Forge crafting, NPC quests, mode drops, evolutions or bundles.

faq.question: Do Lucky Spins guarantee a rare class?
faq.answer: No. Lucky Spins improve the higher-rarity distribution, but every result is still a roll and the Exotic chance remains very small.

faq.question: Should I buy another class slot?
faq.answer: An extra slot is useful before risky rerolls or long special unlocks because it lets you preserve a leveled class and its Aspect.

faq.question: Are the rarest classes always the best?
faq.answer: No. Rarity describes access. Real performance also depends on damage uptime, AoE, mobility, protection, class level, Aspect pairing and the content being cleared.

sections.heading: Is There an Official Dungeon Lootr Trello?
sections.intro: No official Trello board is currently published through ClickBytes channels. Avoid boards that use the game name without a clear developer connection.
paragraphs: Players searching for a Trello usually want class lists, update notes, codes, item details and progression help. Those needs are better served right now by the official Discord for announcements, the Roblox page for the live experience and focused guide pages for structured tables.

If ClickBytes publishes a board later, the destination should appear through an official channel before it is treated as the game's Trello. Until then, there is no reason to risk a copied login page, unrelated invite or fan board presented as official.

hero.eyebrow: Use the right gem on the right class
hero.heading: Dungeon Lootr Aspect Gems Guide
hero.lead: Dungeon Lootr Aspect Gems are consumable items that roll a random passive Aspect onto the class you currently have equipped. This guide explains the confirmed way to get and use a gem, how to choose the receiving Class, and what to check before you commit a limited resource.

sections.heading: What Are Aspect Gems in Dungeon Lootr?
sections.intro: An Aspect Gem is the item used to add a random passive combat trait to your currently equipped Class.
paragraphs: The gem is not an Aspect selector. Using one creates a random roll, so the useful decision you control is which Class is active when you spend it. The resulting Aspect changes how that Class performs through a passive trigger or bonus; it does not give you a new Class and it is separate from ordinary gear upgrades.

That distinction is the heart of this Dungeon Lootr Aspect Gem guide. Players looking for every passive effect, the strongest Aspect, or an Aspect tier list should use the dedicated Aspects guide. Here, the focus stays on the item itself: obtaining a confirmed gem reward, using it correctly, checking the target Class, and planning the next roll without wasting resources.

sections.heading: How to Get Aspect Gems in Dungeon Lootr
sections.intro: Promotional codes are the confirmed source covered by current references, and code status can change without notice.
paragraphs: The verified September 2026 reward record lists GIVEMEGEMSPLEASE as granting three Aspect Gems. Open the current Codes page before redeeming it: that page is maintained as the time-sensitive source for working and expired rewards, while this guide avoids turning one code snapshot into a permanent promise.

Redeem a working code through the game's code menu, then check your Inventory for the reward. A spelling error, an expired promotion, or an unmet in-game requirement can prevent a code from working. Copy the exact text and follow the redemption notes on the Codes page instead of relying on an old video or comment.

Other modes and progression systems may change across updates, but the public material used for this page does not establish a dependable Aspect Gem drop table, rate, shop price, or guaranteed milestone schedule. For that reason, this guide does not name an unconfirmed farming route. Treat the live game's reward panel and ClickBytes announcements as the final check whenever a patch adds a new source.

sections.heading: How to Use an Aspect Gem
sections.intro: Equip the intended Class first, because the random Aspect is applied to the Class active at the moment you press Use.

steps.heading: Choose your target Class
steps.description: Equip the Class you genuinely plan to play. Pause on the class screen and verify its name before opening the item.

steps.heading: Open the Inventory
steps.description: Enter the Inventory and select the Aspect Gem. Do not use it from habit while a temporary or test Class is equipped.

steps.heading: Press Use once
steps.description: Use the selected gem to make one random Aspect roll onto the equipped Class. The documented flow does not let you choose a specific result.

steps.heading: Confirm the result
steps.description: Return to the Class panel and read the Aspect name and current tooltip. The live description is the best reference for its present trigger and effect.

steps.heading: Test before rolling again
steps.description: Try the Class in safe, familiar content so you can see whether the passive suits its normal attacks, skills, defense, or movement.

paragraphs: The most important moment is step one, not the random result. Dungeon Lootr Aspect Gems act on the currently equipped Class, so a correct Inventory sequence can still produce the wrong account decision if you forgot to switch away from a Class you were testing. Take a few seconds to verify the target before consuming the item.

sections.heading: Which Class Receives the Aspect?
sections.intro: The Class equipped when you use the gem receives the new random Aspect.
paragraphs: Think of the Class as the destination and the Aspect Gem as a one-use delivery. Opening the Inventory does not change that destination. If you switch among several Classes, return to the Class screen immediately before spending the gem and confirm that your intended build is active.

The roll is not described as an account-wide passive or a loose item that you can assign later. This makes Class selection a resource-planning decision. Review the Classes guide to understand your options, then compare overall Class performance if you are unsure which one will remain in your regular dungeon rotation.

A practical target is a Class you already enjoy, can use consistently, and expect to keep. A rare label alone does not guarantee that you will like the moveset. Playing the Class first gives you a better sense of whether a random passive will support the actions you actually perform.

sections.heading: What Happens to Your Existing Aspect?
sections.intro: Treat a Class with an Aspect you value as a protected resource and inspect the live confirmation text before using another gem.
paragraphs: A Dungeon Lootr Aspect Gem rolls a new passive onto the equipped Class. The documented use flow does not establish a separate storage slot, undo button, refund, lock, or guaranteed recovery method for the previous roll. If you are unwilling to lose a useful pairing, stop before pressing Use and keep the gem for another Class.

This cautious rule remains useful even when the interface changes: read any confirmation prompt, check the existing Aspect on the Class panel, and only continue if you accept the displayed outcome. Do not assume that closing the game, switching Classes, or contacting support will reverse a deliberate roll.

sections.heading: When Should You Spend Aspect Gems?
sections.intro: Spend after you have chosen a long-term Class and can accept a random result; save when your roster is still changing.

subsections.heading: Spend on a proven main Class
paragraphs: Use a gem when you have played the Class enough to understand its normal rotation and expect it to remain useful. This makes it easier to judge the resulting passive from real play rather than from rarity or visual effects alone.
bullets: Confirm the exact Class before opening Inventory.
Keep at least one reliable dungeon-clearing option available.
Read the new Aspect tooltip before making another roll.

subsections.heading: Save during roster changes
paragraphs: Hold your Dungeon Lootr Aspect Gems if you are still replacing Classes frequently or have not decided which playstyle you prefer. Saving preserves the choice to invest later; an immediate random roll may attach value to a Class you soon stop using.
bullets: Do not spend simply because the item is available.
Avoid chasing a named Aspect without spare gems.
Use current Class and Aspect guides as decision aids, not guarantees.

paragraphs: These are planning recommendations, not official game rules. A player who enjoys experimentation may accept more random rolls, while a new account usually gains more from preserving scarce options until its Class plan is clearer.

sections.heading: Aspect Gem Tips for New Players
sections.intro: A short checklist prevents most avoidable mistakes with a random, Class-bound roll.

subsections.heading: Before using a gem
paragraphs: Open the Class screen, identify the active Class, and note any Aspect already shown. Then decide whether you are comfortable changing that build before you enter the Inventory.
bullets: Claim only codes that are still marked working.
Verify the equipped Class name twice.
Keep the gem if the current Aspect is already useful.
Do not expect to choose the random passive.

subsections.heading: After using a gem
paragraphs: Read the in-game tooltip before searching for a build recommendation. Patch values can move, while the current Class panel shows the version you are actually playing. Test the trigger during normal attacks and skills, then compare its role with the Aspects guide.
bullets: Judge the effect in the Class's normal rotation.
Separate a poor passive match from an unfamiliar Class.
Avoid an immediate second roll until you understand the first.

faq.question: How do you get Aspect Gems in Dungeon Lootr?
faq.answer: Promotional codes are a confirmed source. The September 2026 reward record lists GIVEMEGEMSPLEASE for three Aspect Gems, but code status can change, so check the current Codes page before redeeming it.

faq.question: How do you use an Aspect Gem?
faq.answer: Equip the target Class, open Inventory, select the Aspect Gem, and press Use. One random Aspect is applied to the Class you have equipped, so confirm the Class before consuming the gem.

faq.question: Which class gets the new Aspect?
faq.answer: The Class equipped when you press Use receives the random Aspect. Check the Class screen immediately before opening your Inventory.

faq.question: Can an Aspect Gem replace an existing Aspect?
faq.answer: A gem rolls a new passive onto the equipped Class. If you want to keep the Aspect already shown on that Class, do not use another gem until the live confirmation text makes the outcome clear.

faq.question: Should new players save Aspect Gems?
faq.answer: Saving is sensible while your Class roster is changing. Spend when you have a Class you plan to keep, understand its playstyle, and accept that the Aspect result is random.
